new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
VP of Quality – Structural Steel & Bridge Fabrication

**Confidential Fabricator**

The cost of poor quality rarely sits in one department.

Production loses hours to repairs.

Project managers spend time chasing answers.

Shipping loses its window.

And the customer remembers who had to explain the delay.

That’s when quality becomes a leadership issue.

A large-scale structural steel and bridge fabricator is hiring a
**VP of Quality**
to set the quality strategy and make it work across engineering, fabrication and project delivery.

You’ll set expectations with department leaders, use data on rework and audit findings to decide where to act first, and build a quality team that can support the business as it grows.

You’ll need the technical credibility to challenge a welding or inspection decision and the judgment to know when a recurring issue calls for investment, a process change or clearer ownership.

**What they’re looking for**

* Senior quality leadership in structural steel, bridge fabrication or comparable heavy welded fabrication
* Experience owning a quality management system and leading quality managers or inspection teams
* Strong knowledge of AWS D1.1, AWS D1.5 and AISC certification requirements
* Evidence of measurable improvements in rework, delivery performance or customer outcomes
* Confidence representing the business with customers, auditors and third-party inspectors

**Why it’s worth a conversation**

* Executive influence over how quality decisions are made across the business
* State-of-the-art facility: 2000+ tonnes a month
* Complex steel and bridge work where those decisions have a real impact on cost and delivery
* Scope to shape the quality team, systems and standards as the business grows

If you’ve changed how a fabrication business manages quality, I’d like to hear what you changed and what improved.

**Apply on LinkedIn or message me directly for a confidential conversation.**

new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean
new_roles.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.
 
 
Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
 
 
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

**Position Success Criteria**

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.
 
 
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
 
 
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.
 
 
Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.
 
 
You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.
 
 
To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.
 
 
We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

new_roles.title: Head of Global Quality Strategic Initiatives
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**POSITION SUMMARY**
The Head of Global Quality Strategic Initiatives is responsible for defining, leading and executing enterprise-wide initiatives that strengthen TransMedics’ global quality management system (QMS), enhance regulatory compliance, improve product quality and patient safety, and advance operational excellence across the product lifecycle.
 
 
Partnering closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams, this leader translates business priorities into measurable quality outcomes. The role drives complex transformation programs, anticipates emerging quality and regulatory risks, and establishes the processes, governance and metrics needed to support growth while maintaining high standards of safety, effectiveness and compliance.
 
 
The successful candidate combines deep medical device quality and regulatory expertise with strategic vision, strong business acumen and exceptional program leadership, with the ability to influence at every level of a global organization.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
This position is responsible for, but not limited to, the following:
 
 

* Develop and execute a multi-year global quality roadmap aligned with business priorities, regulatory expectations and patient safety. Identify systemic issues and emerging risks, prioritize transformation initiatives, and integrate quality priorities into business planning, product development and growth.
* Lead a portfolio of cross-functional quality programs with clear scope, milestones, resources, accountability and measurable outcomes. Establish executive steering committees, decision rights and escalation paths; resolve barriers, recommend investment priorities and track business impact and sustained results.
* Improve and harmonize the global QMS in line with FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, EU MDR and other applicable requirements. Strengthen process ownership, management review and effectiveness monitoring while accommodating regional requirements and local operating needs.
* Oversee improvement programs spanning document and records management, design and manufacturing controls, risk management, supplier quality, nonconformance, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), change control and post-market processes.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs and site Quality leaders to assess regulatory changes and lead enterprise remediation programs addressing audit findings, regulatory observations and emerging risks. Support FDA inspections and external audits, resolve root causes, and embed sustainable inspection readiness.
* Define enterprise quality KPIs and key risk indicators covering CAPA effectiveness, complaints, nonconformances, audit findings, suppliers and product quality. Build consistent dashboards and executive reporting that improve visibility into risks, trends and program progress.
* Sponsor electronic QMS, quality data integration, advanced analytics and appropriate AI-enabled initiatives within applicable validation, privacy, security and regulatory controls. Promote data integrity, traceability and evidence-based decisions.
* Partner with functional leaders to strengthen product risk management, complaint handling, adverse event reporting, field action assessment and post-market monitoring from development and design transfer through manufacturing and post-market surveillance. Lead analysis of recurring issues and systemic failure modes to improve detection, containment and prevention.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma and risk-based problem-solving to reduce rework, scrap, variation and the cost of poor quality while protecting compliance and patient safety. Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain and site leaders to improve process capability and supplier performance, replicate best practices and measure benefits.
* Advise the Chief Regulatory Officer and executive leadership on quality priorities, systemic risks and transformation opportunities; communicate with the Board as appropriate. Influence priorities and resource decisions, mentor quality and program leaders, and lead training and change management that build accountability, transparency and lasting quality ownership.
* Collaborate with IT/Digital, Finance, Human Resources and other internal partners, and engage regulatory authorities, notified and certification bodies, external auditors, strategic suppliers, consultants and industry organizations as needed.
* Success will be measured by on-time transformation milestones; stronger QMS effectiveness and consistency; fewer recurring issues, overdue corrective actions and repeat audit findings; sustained inspection readiness; and measurable improvements in product quality, complaint trends, supplier performance and cost of poor quality.
* Perform other TransMedics tasks and duties as assigned.

**Management Responsibilities**
Convene and lead cross-functional teams, establish program governance, and develop and mentor quality and program leaders within the approved mandate, budget and governance structure. Direct-report responsibilities are to be confirmed. Formal authority for regulatory decisions, product disposition, quality approvals and regulatory reporting remains with the accountable functions under company procedures.
 
 
**PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES**
This is an on-site role in Andover or Somerville, MA, with approximately 10–20% travel. Additional essential physical requirements, if applicable, are to be confirmed.
 
 
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory Affairs or a related technical discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in medical devices, combination products or another highly regulated healthcare industry, including significant leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Affairs, quality transformation or enterprise program management.
* Proven success leading complex quality improvement, remediation or organizational change programs across business units, manufacturing sites and geographies, translating strategy into executable plans and measurable, sustainable results.
* Strong knowledge of FDA medical device requirements, including QMSR, and working knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR and applicable global medical device frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with CAPA, nonconformances, complaints, design controls, supplier quality, change management, audits, remediation and post-market surveillance; understanding of root cause analysis, process validation, manufacturing controls and QMS effectiveness.
* Familiarity with electronic QMS platforms, quality data analytics and computerized system validation or assurance (CSV/CSA) principles.
* Ability to influence senior executives and stakeholders in a global matrix organization, communicate complex issues clearly, and drive decisions without relying on direct authority.
* Demonstrated strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, change leadership and talent development, with sound risk-based judgment, integrity and accountability for product quality, patient safety and regulatory compliance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related field.
* Professional certifications in quality (ASQ CQE or CMQ/OE), regulatory affairs (RAC), program management (PMP), Lean Six Sigma or change management.
* Experience with MasterControl.

As part of our long-term growth plans, TransMedics is excited to announce our plan to relocate our headquarters (HQ) to Somerville, MA by 2028. We chose this location because we believe it is a place where innovation will thrive. Our new state-of-the-art headquarters is designed to support collaboration, creativity, and discovery. We believe this will be a place where we can continue to do things few thought possible in organ transplantation to help patients.
*Specific timing and role impact may vary.*
TransMedics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company transforming organ transplant therapy for patients worldwide. Our mission is to help save more patients’ lives by increasing access to viable donor organs for those who are awaiting an organ transplant. To accomplish this mission, we partner closely with transplant stakeholders worldwide and help expand their access to healthy donor organs, while delivering the highest quality technology, service, clinical care and outcomes.
 
 
Driven by a passion for improving patient care, we make the impossible possible and keep our employees at the center of everything we do. Together, we strive to enhance the quality of life for transplant recipients and their families, fostering hope and healing in the journey toward better health.
 
 
**Maximize your potential at TransMedics, Inc.**
www.TransMedics.com
 
 
TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation. The expected base salary range for this role is $232,800-$331,350, which represents the company’s current good-faith estimate of compensation for this position. Actual salary will depend on factors such as, but not limited to, candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific work location. This role may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and wellness resources). We comply with all U.S. pay transparency laws and do not request or consider salary history.

new_roles.title: VP, Foundry Operations
new_roles.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.
 
 
At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.
 
 
Requisition ID: 79081
 
 
**Description**
The Vice President of Foundry Operations provides global leadership for Skyworks' external wafer-foundry manufacturing network. The executive owns the operating system that converts technology and product roadmaps into predictable supply, benchmark yield and zero-defect quality, competitive cost, timely NPI ramps, and resilient high-volume production.
 
 
The role integrates Foundry Operations with Foundry Engineering and Supplier Quality, serving as the primary executive interface to strategic foundry partners and aligning Business Units, Design, Product Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Finance, and Foundry Technology.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Global Foundry Strategy & Executive Supplier Leadership
 
 
Define and execute the external foundry operating strategy aligned with product, technology, supply, cost, continuity, compliance, and resilienc
 
 
Lead executive supplier relationships, governance, business reviews, escalations, and joint improvement roadmaps with strategic foundry partners
 
 
Represent Global Operations with foundry executive leadership, communicating performance expectations, transformation priorities, audits, Si technology node HVM readiness, and joint improvement commitments
 
 
Delivery Execution
 
 
Own operational execution from purchase-order issuance through wafer delivery and goods receipt, with transparent supply visibility and disciplined recovery plans
 
 
Manage cycle-time performance, technology transfer and capacity expansion readiness, production ramps, and hot lot management. Partner with SCM, Sourcing, Engineering, and Business Units to protect Skyworks revenue
 
 
Ensure supply plans are feasible and on schedule, with transparent visibility, rapid escalation, and disciplined recovery plans that reflect revenue, absorption, manufacturing cost, and ROI
 
 
Foundry Engineering, Yield, Quality & Process Control
 
 
Drive benchmark probe and final-test yield across external foundries through defect-density benchmarks, product data, and structured yield roadmaps, backed by robust in-line metrology, PCM, SPC/WECO, FDC, and critical-parameter controls
 
 
Establish a zero-defect, source-containment culture and systematically improve Mean-Time-to-Detect and Mean-Time-to-React using real-time indicators of emerging risk
 
 
Quality-excursion containment, root-cause analysis, material disposition, corrective action, verification of non-recurrence (8D reviews), and foundry change-control governance
 
 
NTI to NPI and HVM Ramp Readiness
 
 
Global Operations quality rigor and design for manufacturing through an end-to-end Foundry Ramp Readiness system (NTI oversight, pre-ramp readiness, ramp verification, clean launch, HVM stabilization, and critical production mass) with defined gates, ownership, and escalation
 
 
Verify foundry capability, capacity, yield, quality, cycle time, and supply before ramp and customer commitments, partnering with Foundry Technology, Design, Product Engineering, Quality, SCM, and Business Units to close gaps and protect schedules
 
 
**Responsibilities Continued**
Competitive Performance & Operations Excellence
 
 
Deploy and sustain the Performance Management System (PMS) within Foundry Operations
 
 
Establish competitive benchmarks, aggressive KPI targets, review cadence, and continuous-improvement roadmaps across technology, cost, productivity, quality, yield, cycle time, delivery, and responsiveness
 
 
Cost, Productivity & Financial Performance
 
 
Own foundry VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) cost and productivity roadmaps, yield improvement, cycle time, capacity utilization, and supplier value creation
 
 
Partner with Sourcing and Supply chain on capacity commitments, long-term agreements, and NRE, balancing cost, quality, delivery, technology access, continuity, and compliance in supplier decisions
 
 
Digital Operations, Analytics & Organizational Leadership
 
 
Automate repetitive workflows and provide early warnings of excursions, delivery misses, capacity constraints, and cycle-time changes
 
 
Use analytics and a single source of operational truth to prioritize action, monitor PDCA closure, and improve decision speed and accountability
 
 
Lead and develop a global, matrixed, and multicultural team spanning fab operations, engineering, yield, supplier quality, and analytics; build succession depth and critical capabilities
 
 
Communicate decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recovery plans with executive presence across internal leaders, foundries, foundry suppliers, and, when required, Skyworks customers
 
 
**Required Experience And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related discipline required; master's degree, MBA, or advanced technical degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive semiconductor manufacturing, foundry, technology development, product engineering, supply chain, or operations leadership experience, including significant global responsibility.
* Deep end-to-end understanding of wafer fabrication, critical process modules, design/process interaction, yield ramp, process control, quality systems, NPI, and high-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success managing external foundries, executive supplier relationships, capacity, technology transfers, production ramps, quality excursions, and cross-functional recovery programs.
* Proven ability to use operational data, analytics, and insights to drive execution; experience with Power BI or comparable business-intelligence tools is valued.
* Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to operate at strategic and hands-on levels across technical, commercial, and operational issues.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

**Desired Experience And Skills**

* Strategic thinking and semiconductor business acumen
* People and organizational leadership
* Change leadership and operational transformation
* Decisive, data-based judgment under uncertainty
* Customer focus and cross-functional influence
* Accountability for results, ethics, safety, and quality

The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is currently USD $206,900 - $454,100 per year. Starting base pay will depend on relevant experience and skills, training and education, business needs, market demands, the ultimate job duties and requirements, and work location. Skyworks has different base pay ranges for different work locations in the U.S. Benefits include access to healthcare benefits (including a premium-free medical plan option), a 401(k) plan and company match, an employee stock purchase plan, paid time off (including vacation, sick/wellness, parental leave), among others. Employees are eligible to participate in an incentive plan, and certain roles are also eligible for additional awards, including recognition and stock. These incentives and awards are based on individual and/or company performance.
 
 
Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Skyworks strives to create an accessible workplace; if you need an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@skyworksinc.com.

new_roles.title: Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Bold Thinking. World Changing.**
At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. Automotive safety enhancements, life-saving medical devices, consumer electronics and American security require semiconductors. Working in our Minnesota headquarters, Florida, or Texas location — employees join together to improve the world.
 
 
**Explore what’s possible.**
Joining our U.S. - based team means contributing to and learning about the commercialization of some of the most exciting technologies the world has ever seen. We are turning “science fiction” into everyday reality through technologies such as superconducting, 3D integrated circuits or computer chips, carbon nanotubes, photonic logic devices, micro electro-mechanical systems and other emerging device topologies. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Our customers include emerging leaders who rely on our intellectual property security and quality manufacturing services.
 
 
**Step into the future.**
SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds.
 
 
**Are you bold thinking?**
Find your place on our team and help us change the world!
 
 
**Primary Objective**
Join an innovative semiconductor manufacturing organization at the forefront of advanced technology and manufacturing excellence. The Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing owns the operational, financial, and strategic leadership of the Bloomington fabrication facility, including the Advanced Technology Services (ATS) Process Engineering Technician team. This role ensures the factory achieves world-class safety, quality, output, cycle time, and cost performance while directing a 24/7 organization and partnering across engineering, planning, and quality teams to meet all customer and business commitments.
 
 
In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end operational execution, strategic planning, budgetary ownership, and leadership to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient semiconductor manufacturing. You will be responsible for driving absolute excellence across safety, quality, output, cost optimization, and ensuring smooth production flow to consistently meet internal and external customer quality and on-time delivery (OTD) commitments, and fab velocity metrics / key performance indicators (KPIs).
 
 
The successful candidate will own the organizational design and talent strategy for their organization, serving as a role model and lead a highly matrixed organization consisting of the Manufacturing team, Process Engineering Technicians group, and Flow Engineers. This role is expected to partner closely with Program Managers, Technical Leads, Wafer Planning, Manufacturing, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development teams to improve operational performance, resolve manufacturing constraints, and deliver business objectives. This leader will play a critical role in transforming factory capabilities to meet strict customer commitments and flexible demand by influencing long-range capacity and setting standards for the MN fab operations organization.
 
 
**Major Areas Of Accountability**

* Operations Leadership: Lead the daily and long-term operational execution in the fab, as well as the ATS technician and flow engineer teams to meet all production starts, output targets, yield expectations, cycle time goals, and quality standards, including setting clear priorities for the organization. Direct, develop, and coach the 24/7 operations teams—including Production, ATS Process Engineering Technicians, and Flow Engineers—to ensure capability, accountability, and organizational readiness.
* Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and empower the Production team, Process Engineering Technicians and Flow Engineers to provide effective manufacturing support, maintain production continuity, and resolve process and workflow issues
* Budgetary Responsibility: Own the fab operating budget, including labor, materials, maintenance, and operational spending; drive cost-reduction initiatives and evaluate capital investments using ROI-based decision-making.
* Wafer Planning and Customer Delivery: Partner with Wafer Planning and Program Management to align schedules, capacity, and customer priorities; identify delivery risks and oversee recovery plans to maintain on time delivery (OTD) performance.
* Manufacturing Performance: Partner with Industrial Engineers, and drive continuous improvement in throughput, cycle time, WIP management, yield, quality, equipment availability, and manufacturing cost using data-driven decision-making and structured problem-solving.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development to resolve production constraints, improve equipment readiness, and maintain stable manufacturing operations.
* Operational Excellence: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including customer OTD, cycle time, throughput, equipment availability, and quality. Promote standardization, disciplined execution, effective escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Talent Development: Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, collaboration, and development of technical and operational talent. Responsible for the organizational design and talent strategy of these teams, with a focus on cultivating and retaining key talent, developing future leaders and preparing current leaders for the next level role.

**Required Qualifications**- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related technical discipline.
- Experience: Minimum 12 years in semiconductor manufacturing or operations; minimum 5+ years leading fab operations in a senior manager or director capacity within a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
- Skills:

* Demonstrated ability to improve manufacturing performance (throughput, cycle time, yield, cost, and customer delivery).
* Expertise in wafer planning, WIP management, or production scheduling.
* Strong capability in statistical process control (SPC), structured problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated leadership with large technical teams, with an ability to communicate and collaborate cross-functionally, delivering results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proven track record of managing a 24/7 manufacturing organization and guiding cross-functional teams through technical tool or yield crises.
* Citizenship: US Citizen required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to enter the cleanroom in full PPE to provide technical and operational support.
* Ability to navigate multi-level fab environments, including prolonged walking and standing when needed.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.*
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant technical discipline.
* Experience: Deep knowledge of advanced Complimentary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) nodes, fab toolsets (Lithography, Etch, Diffusion, Thin Films, Chemical Mechanical Polish, Metrology, Metals), and factory automation systems.
* Skills: Experience driving major manufacturing transformations, automation or digitization initiatives, or large-scale capacity improvements.

**The annual salary range for this role is $159440 - $239,160. Pay offered is based on many factors, including, but not limited to, the job-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate.**
SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including 401k match, and life insurance.
 
 
Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on-site fitness facility, and an on-site self-serve market.
 
 
SkyWater complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities unless doing so would cause an undue hardship. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. To request reasonable accommodations, to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 952-851-5200 or Recruiting@SkyWatertechnology.com.
 
 
**EOE, including disability/vets**
We will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment or gift cards, or provide financial information before a formal offer of employment has been accepted. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to represent our company, please verify its authenticity by contacting our recruitment team at recruiting@skywatertechnology.com before responding.

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

**Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* **10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams**
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree
 **Physical Requirements**

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

new_roles.title: Director, Manufacturing Excellence - Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Title**
: Director, Manufacturing Excellence - Engineering

**Reports to:**
AVP, Manufacturing Excellence (ME) - Engineering - BKK Office

**Location**
: NYC Corporate office, TriBeCa

**Estimated Base Salary:**
$190,000 - $215,000 annually

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base pay is one component of Company’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

**Overview**

The Director, Manufacturing Engineer, in conjunction with the AVP of ME, will assist the NY Design and PD teams in engineering new product. They will help troubleshoot engineering challenges from design inception, attend DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and CTM (Concept to Manufacturing) meetings, with the intention of starting as early as possible to foresee possible issues and bottle necks in production. Collaborate with the DY Shop to ensure final production methods are being considered when developing techniques and finishes for Design Approval. Oversee all ECN Projects from start to completion. Work closely with Manufacturing Partners, remotely and on-site, throughout the development process to ensure engineering standards are upheld. As a hands-on technical leader in New York, this Director role will also provide bench-level support for the Women’s Mainline project, work directly with vendors across the US and Europe, and mentor the junior Manufacturing Excellence team member in NY through coaching, teaching, and day-to-day technical guidance.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Work closely with NY based design leadership early in the development process to ensure engineering needs are met
* Serve as a hands-on bench partner on the Women’s Mainline project, validating construction, finishing, and manufacturing methods while supporting the NY design and product development teams.
* Work daily with BKK ME Team to promote inter-office cohesion
* Coordinate closely with the Bangkok Manufacturing Excellence team to align technical standards, share learnings, and support a consistent global manufacturing strategy.
* Work closely with Product Development Team to evaluate and determine best practices for producing Company Jewelry
* Provide direct technical coaching and mentoring to the junior Manufacturing Excellence team member in New York, including training in problem-solving, vendor communication, and engineering best practices.
* Interact closely with vendor base (with focus on domestic and Italian vendors) to guarantee understanding of first sample execution, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, ensure QC standards are met and communicate learnings to cross functional teams
* Expand direct technical support to vendors across the US and Europe, with a hands-on role in resolving sample issues, improving manufacturability, and closing the loop on critical engineering actions.
* Document best practices in a Manufacturing Excellence Manual with ongoing revisions and updates as needed
* Participant in the R&D, DFM & CTM Committees
* Partner with R&D team to vet manufacturing feasibility
* Partner with the DY Shop on creating prototypes and reference samples for design consideration and vendor reference during sampling phase
* Own ECN projects including vendor communication, inspecting models and assembly methods, coming up with solutions or alternatives to correct known issues, obtain final updated vendor samples that pass DY QC and communicate to repair team when solutions are implemented
* Keep up to date on new manufacturing techniques and technologies
* Domestic and international travel required

**Essential Qualifications**

* Education: Four-year BA or BS degree in Mechanical Engineering/Industrial Design
* Minimum 8+ years of practical Jewelry Manufacturing experience (including production manufacturing) OR equivalent tenured jewelry manufacturing experience
* Extensive hands-on model making and jewelry assembly experience in sterling silver, gold alloys, platinum, Titanium and Aluminum
* Extensive knowledge of Jewelry casting, including rubber mold and wax production
* Extensive knowledge of Stone Setting Techniques including Hand Pave, Pin Set, Bezel Setting, Prong Setting, baguette setting and invisible setting. Hands on experience preferred
* A thorough knowledge of Electro-plating with White and Black Rhodium including both pen plating and bath plating
* Experience with multiple finishing techniques such as Oxidation on Silver, Satin, Burnished and Mechanical Finishing
* A high level of understanding of RHINO 3D Version 8 and Rapid Prototyping
* A strong understanding of jewelry mechanisms such as clasps, hinges, and springs
* A keen understanding of Stamping and Machining techniques
* Ability to troubleshoot problems at every stage of the jewelry manufacturing process
* A good sense of Design
* Computer Skills: Familiarity with Rhino, Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and mechanical drawing software and /or Adobe Photo Client
* Demonstrated hands-on bench jewelry manufacturing experience with the ability to analyze complex product construction, manufacturing methods, and engineering challenges.
* Proven ability to mentor and develop engineering talent while providing technical leadership across cross-functional teams.

**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
The Process Engineering department supports technical and scientific activities related to the manufacture of pharmaceutical products in AbbVie facilities or in contract facilities. The Director, through his/her section managers and direct reporting lines, will manage a technically diverse staff of highly specialized engineers and scientists. He/she is a key link between development organizations and operations/third party contract manufacturers and ensures a seamless link between pilot scale and full-scale manufacture. The director is accountable for all the activities of the department and provides technical/scientific and business leadership for the department. The director partners with manufacturing and quality in the identification, definition, and execution of projects and delivers technical requirements for the launch of products and supports the development of innovative solutions to problems and opportunities.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Communicates and collaborates with internal (manufacturing, quality, engineering, S&T and other areas) and external partners to provide effective technical and business leadership in line with site goals and objectives.
* Maintain and direct a highly diversified cross functional staff of professionals to ensure that all aspects of CMC life cycle management are completed on time, within budget and meet highest scientific, regulatory, quality, marketing and commercial standards
* Develops engineering objectives and strategies that advance the site, and continually looks for opportunities for process optimization, cost avoidance and cost reduction.
* Develop and communicate cost estimates, business plans, timelines and contingency plans to accomplish project and departmental objectives within agreed time scope.
* Participate in capital plan input and capital project execution to advance manufacturing capabilities
* Make final decisions related to project responsibilities
* Represent AbbVie during audits to regulatory agencies (US/ROW as appropriate) by supplying verbal or written information with active participation.
* Responsible for ensuring that all members of the Engineering team follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition.
* Provide leadership, coaching, training, and mentoring to direct reports. Negotiates, secures, oversees and ensures that all resources are available to meet the demands of the projects and site goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering discipline (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical) is required to provide technical expertise.
* 10 + years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry formulation, including at least 4+ years of managerial experience.
* Knowledge of AbbVie Engineering standards.
* Demonstrated leadership and team building skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities.
* Proven track record of managing projects through to completion.
* Excellent communication skills with layers of management.

Additional Information
 
 
Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:
 
 

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
Position Overview
 
 
TransMedics is seeking a
**Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering**
to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.
 
 
**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**
As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.
 
 
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

Work Environment
 
 
This position operates in both office and manufacturing floor environments and requires a leader who is comfortable engaging directly with engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.
 
 
**Compensation & Benefits**
TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation.
 
 
The expected base salary range for this position is
**$220,600 – $314,050 annually**
, representing the company's current good-faith estimate of compensation.
 
 
Actual compensation will depend on factors including candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and specific work location.
 
 
**This Position May Also Be Eligible For**

* Performance-based bonuses
* Equity compensation
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings benefits
* Paid time off
* Wellness resources

TransMedics complies with all applicable U.S. pay transparency laws and does not request or consider salary history.
 
 
**About TransMedics**
TransMedics is transforming organ transplantation through innovative technologies designed to improve the availability, utilization, and outcomes of donor organs.
 
 
Our mission is to help save more lives by advancing the science and technology of organ preservation and transplantation.
 
 
Join a growing organization where engineering innovation, technical excellence, and meaningful impact come together to advance life-saving technology.
 
 
This is a full-time,
**on-site position**
currently based at TransMedics' facility in Andover, MA.
 
 
TransMedics is preparing to transition operations to a new facility in
**Somerville, MA**
. Candidates should be aware of this upcoming move and must be willing and able to work on-site at both locations as the transition occurs.

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering and Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Location:**
Export, Pennsylvania

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

www.kt-grant.com

**About the Role**

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on
**Director of Engineering and Manufacturing**
to lead the technical integrity, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement of our production facilities. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will bridge the gap between engineering innovation and shop-floor execution—overseeing complex manufacturing departments (including welding, machining, assembly, paint, and engineering) while driving job-level profitability, safety, and on-time delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational & Multi-Site Production Leadership**

* Direct daily manufacturing operations across multiple departments (welding, machine shop, assembly, paint, and engineering) to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and customer commitments.
* Establish and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), lean workflows, and best practices to optimize cycle times, equipment utilization, and project coordination.
* Drive job-level profitability by monitoring labor productivity, managing working capital in staging/WIP areas, and executing rigorous cost-control measures.
* Partner with the Safety department to enforce strict regulatory compliance and foster an ethical, safety-first shop-floor culture.

**Engineering Strategy & Technical Execution**

* Define and execute the long-term engineering vision while leading day-to-day activities across mechanical, electrical, and process engineering disciplines.
* Provide technical oversight across the entire product lifecycle—from concept, equipment schematics, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) through assembly and finished goods.
* Collaborate closely with Service and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot complex equipment (including hydraulic systems), manage preventative maintenance, and oversee rolling stock inventory.

**Financial Acumen & Strategic Growth**

* Partner with the CFO to formulate and manage annual Capital Expenditure (CapEx) and program budgets for manufacturing equipment and technology.
* Provide senior leadership with critical costing data and engineering value analyses to reduce Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and expand gross margins.
* Analyze industry trends and economic conditions to position our equipment design and production capabilities for long-term growth.

**Systems Integration & Supply Chain Collaboration**

* Lead the integration and optimization of ERP systems (such as SyteLine) and CAD tools (SolidWorks) into daily manufacturing workflows.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to forecast inventory needs, streamline purchase order flows, maintain material availability, and keep inventory days of supply low.

**Labor Relations & People Management**

* Partner with the Director of HR to manage workforce dynamics within a unionized environment, ensuring collective bargaining agreement compliance and resolving technical or scheduling disputes.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering and production talent.
* Establish and track production KPIs and performance dashboards to drive accountability, timely shop output, and continuous team development.



**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required:**

* **Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial, or Process Engineering (or a related engineering discipline).
* **Experience:**
 5–10+ years of progressive leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams (mechanical, electrical, industrial/process) and complex manufacturing operations within the heavy industrial or heavy metals sector.
* **Labor Relations:**
 Direct experience managing a unionized workforce and navigating collective bargaining agreements.
* **Technical & Systems Proficiency:**
 Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (SyteLine preferred), SolidWorks, KPI dashboards, Microsoft Office, and hydraulic equipment troubleshooting.
* **Financial & Regulatory Acumen:**
 Proven experience with CapEx budgeting, manufacturing cost accounting, COGS reduction, and regulatory compliance.
* **Leadership Traits:**
 Demonstrated ability to make rational, ethical decisions under pressure while balancing customer on-time delivery with shop-floor capacity.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s Degree in Engineering (MSE) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or Six Sigma / Lean certification

new_roles.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
White Bear Lake, MN
 
 
**About Heraeus**
Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.
 
 
**About Heraeus Medevio**
Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.
 
 
To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
**What You’ll Do Every Day**

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
**Curious? Apply now!**
Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.
